http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#com:
Physical archaeological site. Directly subClassOf crm:E27_Site
("piece of land in a particular configuration", CRM definition) as well as
lado:Location and fsl:Site — both of which route through pleiades:Location
→ geosparql:SpatialObject → crm:E53_Place. crm:E27_Site is a subClassOf
crm:E26_Physical_Feature → crm:E18_Physical_Thing → crm:E72_Legal_Object
→ crm:E70_Thing → crm:E1_CRM_Entity, and also via crm:E53_Place.
FSL Wikibase metadata: fsl:certaintyLevel, fsl:certaintyDesc, fsl:spatialType,
fsl:siteType, fsl:hasReference, geosparql:hasGeometry.
PROV-O: prov:wasGeneratedBy → bb5kbc:GeoreferenzierungsAktivitaet
        (use bb5kbc:wurdeGeoreferenziertDurch as the typed subproperty);
        prov:wasAttributedTo → foaf:Person.
